name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Foxglen, Mossbank, and 9 lb go with Boone, Cody, and Mabel, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Cody goes with 9 lb; Trout goes with Willowmere; Mossbank goes with 11 lb.
Boone's weight is higher than both the angler who landed the Catfish and the angler at Mossbank.

Either Mabel belongs to the Pike Family or both members of the East Watershed belong to the Pike Family (but not both).
If 11 lb goes with Willowmere, then at least one of Mossbank goes with Trout, 11 lb goes with Pike, or 9 lb does not go with Cody.
Between 9 lb and 12 lb, one goes with Catfish and the other with Trout.
